svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Order made to size: 3,000 mm wide (along the curb) by 2,419 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (down the slope), with a 1,020 x 670 mm notch at the middle of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rear edge for the solar panel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reinforced hem all round, including the notch; brass or stainless

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eyelets about every 300 mm and at every corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: over the frame; lace each eyelet round the beam below it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with cord. The notch's sides lace round the purlins, its front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge round the panel bearer; the panel covers the notch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit only when forecast gusts are below 15 m/s; take it off before

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: storms (15 minutes or less by unlacing).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: laid on the frame, the hem reaches every edge and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: notch clears the L-feet and rails.
